blocks.text: Humans are endothermic homeotherms. They regulate body temperature through negative feedback mechanism. For example; the thermoreceptors present in skin detect an increase or decrease in body temperature. They send signals to the control centre i.e., hypothalamus which also contains thermoreceptors.
